title: Are we nearing peak K-beauty? Industry experts weigh in…
summary: With K-beauty brands entering numerous US retailers, and Western brands tapping into innovation from Korea – from packaging to ingredients – Cosmetics Business asked industry experts if we are nearing K-beauty saturation, and where the category is heading in 2027

extraction.key_fact: K-뷰티 브랜드가 미국 유통 채널에 잇달아 들어가면서 업계 전문가들이 K-뷰티 포화 여부를 짚었다.
